title: Which season is it?
description:
Get the month from user input then check if the season is Autumn, Winter, Spring or Summer. If the user input is:
September, October or November, the season is Autumn.
December, January or February, the season is Winter.
March, April or May, the season is Spring
June, July or August, the season is Summer

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `get_season(month)`, returning `'Autumn'`, `'Winter'`, `'Spring'`, or `'Summer'` for the given month name.
hints: Group the month names for each season into their own list or set.
Use the `in` operator to check whether month belongs to a given group.
Chain the four checks with if / elif / elif / elif, one per season group.
expected_behavior: Returns the season name that the given month (as a string, e.g. 'September') belongs to.
explanation: Each season maps to a fixed group of three month names. Storing each group as a list and checking membership with `in` lets a simple elif chain pick the season the given month belongs to.
